title: Arkret Delivery Binding Stale Error Body
description: Canonical error body for the delivery_binding_stale federation signal. A receiver that has accepted a member delivery-binding rebind handover returns this when a sender still delivers under the pre-handover binding. Carries new_recipient_service_did, handover_frontier, and a verifiable handover_proof binding the accepted ck.member.state{membership=join} rebind Move. High-risk redirect: senders MUST cross-verify handover_frontier via a non-destination witness and validate handover_proof (reachability, seal-frontier finalization, allowed_recipient_services membership, trust-domain guard) before following. See zh/sync/federation.md §4.1 and registry/error-code-registry.json (delivery_binding_stale / delivery_binding_handover_proof_invalid).

new_recipient_service_did.description: Target Principal Server service DID after rebind. MUST be within the current effective allowed_recipient_services / delivery binding policy allow set.

handover_frontier.description: Handover frontier F that triggered the rebind. MUST equal handover_proof.frontier.

handover_proof.description: Verifiable proof binding the accepted ck.member.state{membership=join} rebind Move that produced the new binding.

actor_id.description: Rebind target principal; MUST equal target_principal_id.

witness.description: Event digest / state witness / inclusion proof of the rebind Move. Sender MUST verify reachability in the Realm Event graph and policy, and that the Move is seal-frontier finalized.
